notes.title: May is Mental Health Awareness month!
notes.content:
Hi all!

We hope you're enjoying playing Zamboni Simulator 2019 as much as we enjoyed making it! You may have noticed the somewhat serious undertones of depression and suicidal ideation in the game. We take those subjects very seriously ourselves, and want to convey how important mental health is, especially in strange times such as these. 

It was always our intent to release this game as free to play. In lieu of payment we ask that you consider donating to one of the following organizations near and dear to us, who are all doing such good work in the way of mental health awareness and suicide prevention.

National Alliance on Mental Illness (NAMI)
American Foundation for Suicide Prevention (AFSP)
Anxiety and Depression Association of America (ADAA)
The Trevor Project
Depression and Bipolar Support Alliance (DBSA)


Thanks everyone for playing!
